presets.name: District closures, areas to draw
presets.description: Closes the six schools the district recommended (end of 2026-27) plus Fairview and Ridgeview (approved, 2028-29). Fairview and Ridgeview areas merge into Northview and Central; the other closing areas are left unassigned for you to draw.

presets.name: Southeast plan A: district receivers only
presets.description: District closures, with the four southeast elementary closures absorbed only by the district's listed receivers, as drawn by the earlier optimizer (which used lower student counts). Walnut Grove and Indian Trail areas still unassigned.

presets.name: Southeast plan B: any adjacent school
presets.description: District closures, with the four southeast elementary closures absorbed by any adjacent open school within 2.5 miles, as drawn by the earlier optimizer (which used lower student counts). Walnut Grove and Indian Trail areas still unassigned.

presets.name: District receivers: 90% cap
presets.description: District closures. The four southeast elementary closures go only to the district's listed receivers, with no receiver above 90% (Pre-K counted) in any year through 2034-35 and no islands. Trips kept under 2 miles where possible; 2 miles cannot be met for everyone at 90%. Walnut Grove and Indian Trail still unassigned.

presets.description: District closures. The four southeast elementary closures go only to the district's listed receivers, with every home within 2 road miles of its new school and no islands, using the lowest peak that allows it (about 111%). Walnut Grove and Indian Trail still unassigned.

presets.name: District option 1
presets.description: Read off the district's Concept 1 map (Nov 2026 boundary presentation). Heritage: west of Indian Creek to Madison Place, east to Brougham. Scarborough: all to Sunnyside. Black Bob: northwest corner to Briarwood, southwest corner to Brougham, the rest to Green Springs. Tomahawk: west of Mur-Len to Havencroft, the rest to Briarwood. Walnut Grove: west of Pflumm to Heatherstone, east to Pleasant Ridge. Also Briarwood east of Black Bob Rd to Regency Place, and Pleasant Ridge's southeast part to Bentwood. Half of Spanish immersion (118) to Arbor Creek.

presets.name: District option 2
presets.description: Read off the district's Concept 2 map (Nov 2026 boundary presentation). Heritage: west of Ridgeview to Madison Place, Ridgeview to Indian Creek to Havencroft, east of Indian Creek to Sunnyside. Scarborough: west of Indian Creek to Madison Place, east to Sunnyside. Black Bob: west part to Brougham, the rest to Green Springs. Tomahawk: all to Briarwood. Walnut Grove: north part and a strip along Pflumm to Heatherstone, the rest to Pleasant Ridge. Also Briarwood south of 143rd to Green Springs, Green Springs by 151st to Brougham, Briarwood east of Black Bob Rd to Regency Place. Half of Spanish immersion (118) to Arbor Creek.

presets.name: District option 3
presets.description: Read off the district's Concept 3 map (Nov 2026 boundary presentation). Heritage: west of Indian Creek to Havencroft, east to Sunnyside. Scarborough: west of Indian Creek to Madison Place, east to Sunnyside. Black Bob: southwest part to Brougham, the rest to Green Springs. Tomahawk: west of Mur-Len to Indian Creek, the rest to Briarwood. Walnut Grove: as option 2 (commercial land by I-35 to Countryside). Also Briarwood south of 143rd to Green Springs, Green Springs north of 143rd to Briarwood, Briarwood east of Black Bob Rd to Regency Place, Indian Creek west of Mur-Len near I-35 to Countryside, and Regency Place's east part to Bentwood. Half of Spanish immersion (118) to Arbor Creek.
